svg.title: How a job moved through Wrenfield before: who held it and how long it waited
svg.text: 05 · THE AUDIT: HOW A JOB MOVES TODAY
Waits · up to 6 days for Sunday
Lisa invoices on Tue or Fri
Nine handoffs, four people, three systems that don’t talk. Paid on average 41 days after the invoice; the invoice itself goes out 8.6 days late.
